title: metadata-protocol: type the six query-options erasures in protocol.ts data reads (findData, getData, cloneData, probeRecord) so their bodies can leave the class
body:
domain:server#4 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbacSXJQqAztgt4UMrS

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding of the #25467 E2 section-3 dev, recorded in the seat ruling 6594932448 on #25467. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (a refactor prerequisite; no user-visible behaviour).

## What happens

`scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json` grandfathers six untyped query-options sites in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (line 37 on `origin/main`): `findData` ×3, `getData`, `cloneData` and `probeRecord`. The baseline only shrinks and is keyed by file, so moving any of those bodies into a module is refused as an addition, and a move is not an exception (`check-query-options-erasure-ratchet.mjs`). That is why cut 4 kept `probeRecord` on the class, and why #25467's E2 section 3 moves only `validateData`, `createData`, `updateData` and `deleteData` (ruling 6594932448).

## Wanted

1. Type each of the six sites, so the erasure goes away rather than moving.
2. `protocol.ts` leaves the baseline: its key reaches 0 and is removed, as the ratchet asks of a fixed file.
3. No behaviour change; the data-read pins pass unchanged.
4. After it lands, #25467 moves the four remaining data-CRUD bodies (`findData`, `getData`, `cloneData`, `probeRecord`) as one more E2 cut.

Serial: after #25467's section-3 PR (same file, under the declared `protocol.ts` freeze, 6594835694 on #27737).

Dedupe: searched `query-options-erasure protocol.ts`, `erasure baseline findData`; nearest is #25467. **New.**

Links back: #25467 (ruling E 6537939895, seat ruling 6594932448), `scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json`.
